criteria.given: A task has a behavioral slice and later code review
then: Red, Green, and behavior-preserving Refactor run before task review; review and correction remain inside the loop; no unconditional outer Refactor pass remains
criteria.reason: Agent semantic behavior and classification require an independent scenario walkthrough; string-matching documents cannot prove these claims.

criteria.given: Review reports local and broader structural suggestions
then: Every valid local suggestion is fixed and re-reviewed; broader horizontal refactors are excluded from the implementation
criteria.reason: Agent semantic behavior and classification require an independent scenario walkthrough; string-matching documents cannot prove these claims.

criteria.given: Review identifies a broader horizontal refactor
then: An attributed later-card draft has tag refactoring and is published on develop through normal integration without breaking writer ownership; interrupted publication retains a handoff
criteria.reason: Agent semantic behavior and classification require an independent scenario walkthrough; string-matching documents cannot prove these claims.

criteria.given: A suggestion would change meaning, behavior, or contracts
criteria.when: The task classifies and handles it
then: Existing-spec defects use TDD correction; necessary redesign enters Spec Change before implementation; neither is silently deferred as optional refactoring
criteria.reason: Agent semantic behavior and classification require an independent scenario walkthrough; string-matching documents cannot prove these claims.

criteria.given: A candidate has rejected/stale approval or failing checks, or the retry limit is reached
criteria.when: The public inner-loop commands dispatch and attempt integration
then: Rejected/stale/failed candidates do not integrate; a freshly approved checked candidate can integrate; retry limits and CLI vocabulary remain unchanged

criteria.given: Pinned TDD skills are prepared for this repository
criteria.when: Public prepare runs, repeats, validates only, or encounters installation failure
then: Both installed skill views receive one authoritative TDD override; pins and unrelated upstream content remain; validation-only runs do not mutate outputs and failures are explicit

criteria.given: A consumer installs, syncs, or upgrades the kit
then: The canonical task-loop contract ships and each supported runtime follows it consistently without losing consumer overlays

criteria.given: The Grill stage reaches a load-bearing decision
criteria.when: The agent asks the human to resolve it
then: Selectable answer options are presented using the active runtime's structured choice control
An optional free-text path can accompany a selected option in the same response
A mutually exclusive Other option alone does not satisfy the free-text requirement
The native control is used only when callable for the current mode and question type and capable of preserving both values
If no usable native control exists, numbered options accept the selected option and additional text in one response
criteria.reason: The user-facing choice interaction and preservation of write-in responses require an independent prompt walkthrough; static strings alone cannot prove the interaction.

criteria.given: A workstream is resumed near a confirmation gate
criteria.when: The current plan's authorized scope is evaluated
then: A missing or stale confirmation is asked only if it blocks an otherwise authorized next action
An explicit plan stop is reported as completion within scope without describing the future gate as missing
criteria.reason: Continuation behavior depends on interpreting authorization and stop boundaries; an independent scenario walkthrough is required.
